problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable convex minimization on a second-countable real Hilbert space. The gradient is globally L-Lipschitz, and a minimizer x★ exists with ‖x0−x★‖≤R. No strong convexity is assumed.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: A query x returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed, with E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). Only gradient samples are supplied; neither objective values nor individual sample functions are available. The extracted budget counts individual oracle calls and is fixed in advance.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedStrongGrowthConvex.lean: spec.admissible; IsRelativeMomentOracle.unbiased. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID. LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace; Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Only a finite central p-th noise moment is required, where 1<p≤2. Infinite variance is permitted when p<2; no exponential-tail assumption is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: relative_error
distinctive_assumptions.details: The stochastic relative-moment condition is E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖^p≤ρ‖∇f(x)‖^p for every x, with ρ≥0. This is a moment bound, not a pointwise relative-error bound. Noise vanishes almost surely at each stationary point.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space may be infinite-dimensional and is a complete, second-countable real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure. All setup parameters, including L>0, R≥0, ρ≥0, p, ε>0, and x0, are public; the objective and oracle distribution are hidden.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedStrongGrowthConvex.lean: Params; spec.Public; spec.publicInput; spec.Instance; spec.valid; spec.admissible.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable point-valued output X whose objective gap f(X)−f(x★) is integrable and has expectation at most ε for a global minimizer x★. No last-iterate or best-iterate requirement is imposed.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[f(X)−f(x★)]≤ε, with expectation over both algorithm randomness and the IID oracle seed sequence.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The smooth convex geometry and expected objective-gap criterion are standard, but the defining oracle assumption is a relative central p-moment bound that permits infinite variance while forcing noise to vanish at stationary points.

descriptionHtml:
Heavy-Tailed Strong-Growth Convex Minimization

We minimize a differentiable convex function f:E→R on a separable real Hilbert space E. Its gradient is L-Lipschitz, with L>0, and a given point x0∈E lies within distance R≥0 of a global minimizer x⋆. At x, the oracle returns an unbiased stochastic gradient g(x,ξ) using independent samples ξ from a probability measure μ on a measurable space Ω. Its noise has pth moment at most ρ∥∇f(x)∥p, where 1<p≤2 and ρ≥0. For ε>0, the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E with integrable objective gap satisfying E[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε, averaging over sampling and algorithm randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, which is equipped with its Borel sigma-algebra. The algorithm receives E, Ω, L, R, ρ, p, ε, and x0; access to f is through the stochastic gradient oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E. For every x,y∈E and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y),∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Initial distance). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Assumption 3 (Relative moment and independent sampling). The map g:E×Ω→E is jointly measurable. For each x∈E, the map g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable under μ, and ∥g(x,⋅)−∇f(x)∥p is integrable under μ. They satisfy Eξ∼μ[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼μ[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥p]≤ρ∥∇f(x)∥p. The oracle uses a sequence (ξk)k≥0 of measurable, mutually independent random variables, each with distribution μ. At call k, a query x∈E receives g(x,ξk). The algorithm’s randomness is independent of this sample sequence.

Queries may be made at any point of E. Let P denote the joint law of the sample sequence and the algorithm’s randomness. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable, its gap f(x¯)−f(x⋆) must be integrable under P, and EP[f(x¯)−f(x⋆)]≤ε.

comparisonHtml:
Convex differentiable f on a separable real Hilbert space, with L-Lipschitz gradient, a minimizer x⋆, and ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. Here L,ε>0, R,ρ≥0, and 1<p≤2. The jointly measurable oracle has integrable samples and integrable central pth moments, with ∫g(x,ω)dμ=∇f(x) and ∫∥g(x,ω)−∇f(x)∥pdμ≤ρ∥∇f(x)∥p. Samples are IID with marginal μ under probability law P. Target: measurable output with integrable gap and ∫[f(output)−f(x⋆)]dP≤ε. Result (1) constructs SplitRobustAcceleration, tuned using L,R,ρ,p,ε; the setup imposes no algorithm restriction.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.HeavyTailedStrongGrowthConvex

open OracleTemplate
open StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  ρ : ℝ
  p : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.linearE Params.completeE Params.measurableE
  Params.borelE Params.countableE Params.measurableΩ

structure IsRelativeMomentOracle {E Ω : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : E → ℝ) (g : E → Ω → E)
    (p ρ : ℝ) : Prop where
  measurable : Measurable (Function.uncurry g)
  integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (g x) μ
  unbiased : ∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂μ = gradient f x
  moment_integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ p) μ
  moment : ∀ x, (∫ ω, ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ p ∂μ) ≤ ρ * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ p

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance q := q.E → ℝ
  Query q := q.E
  Reply q := q.E
  Output q := q.E
  publicInput q := q
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 ≤ q.ρ ∧ 1 < q.p ∧ q.p ≤ 2 ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    IID (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (μ : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) seed => g x seed } ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R) ∧
    IsRelativeMomentOracle (μ : Measure _) f g q.p q.ρ
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => f (output ω) - f xstar) (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, f (output ω) - f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.HeavyTailedStrongGrowthConvex
